## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Implementation

Explain important design, architecture, dependency, or filesystem-safety decisions.

## Validation

- [ ] `swift test` passes
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff for unrelated changes and private data
- [ ] I added or updated focused tests where appropriate
- [ ] I verified the running app when the change affects the interface

## Safety and privacy

Describe any effect on filesystem access, permissions, symbolic links, private metadata, classification, Trash behavior, or destructive actions. Write “None” when the change has no such effect.

## Visual changes

Add screenshots or a short recording for interface changes. Otherwise write “None.”

## Remaining risks

List limitations or unverified behavior. Write “None known” when appropriate.
